title: agenerela/agenerela
summary: AI agents for Unity — let a language model drive NPCs, factions and colonies, constrained to actions you register. Local-first, no cloud required.

title: Joseph-Rus/syftnotes

title: Eljot19/runic
summary: Runic macOS Menu Bar App for AI Usage Cost and Token Tracking

title: chelmooz/maieutik
summary: Moteur de connaissance local-first en Rust : RAG hybride (HNSW + BM25), MCP, garde-fous Laya.

title: ScutiModelServices/MiniCPM52BModel
summary: One HTTP service in front of Ollama that serves MiniCPM5-1B to every project. FastAPI, Docker Compose and nginx, with per-project API tokens and an admin web UI.

title: CristianBernardes/agent-office-microservice
summary: living office of AI agents that plan, debate and ship tasks — local-first, MQTT + Kafka + Ollama, pt/en. Open source.

title: SiddhantTotade/CAISE
summary: Codebase AI Search & Evaluation

title: FAHTHIZ/oasis
summary: The open-source coding agent whose safety lives in the runtime, not the prompt. Any model, from a local 4B to the frontier. CLI, browser, desktop, VS Code.

title: Vironnimo/vbot
summary: Your own AI agents, self-hosted: persistent agents with memory that work with you or on their own, in chat, real terminals, swarms, on schedules and by voice. Any model (subscriptions, API keys, local). Browser, desktop, CLI, Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp.

title: yash-dhanda/vibesmith
summary: Chat-first desktop app that builds software with local models, your own keys, or a Crew of Claude Code + Codex + a local model

title: suflorme/suflor
summary: Toplantılar için sesli asistan. Mac'te canlı döküm; proje belgeleri, tabloları ve geçmiş toplantılardan bağlam; doğru anda kulağına fısıldayan kartlar. Claude, Gemini ya da yerel model. Ses Mac'ten çıkmaz. Teams, Google Meet, Zoom.

title: TomiToivio/LaclauGPT-Multimodal-Analysis
summary: LaclauGPT scripts for multimodal analysis of EP2024 social media videos. Meant to be run as batch jobs on CSC Roihu supercomputer. For research purposes only.

title: fevunge/tache-api
summary: An enterprise-grade command-line task management system—for developers and other CLI's users.  The system manages tasks with priorities, due dates, tags, and interdependencies, using SQLite persistence via Drizzle ORM, and integrates with Ollama for intelligent prioritization suggestions based on the user’s historical patterns.

title: hey-mori/mori-lens
summary: Read anything on your screen in your language. Rest the pointer on a word or sentence and Mori Lens explains it, using a model on your own machine.

title: Pigeon-Home/homing-pigeon
summary: Homing Pigeon is a self-hosted cloud-SI-controlled local agent and protocol. Tell your cloud SI (Grok, ChatGPT, etc.) to send signed jobs via email which then execute on your machine: Linux, macOS, FreeBSD, Windows or any container. An oracle on the host watches to ensure nothing bad or unintended occurs. Modern LLMs, meet: netcat.

title: ashlrai/phantom
summary: Phantom by AshlrAI: an open-source engineering agent workbench for Claude Code, Codex, Devin, Grok and local models. Connect your resources, work with agents, or run an autonomous fleet.

title: seanhudgins/local-ai-starter
summary: Run open-weight AI models on your own PC and Mac, privately reachable over Tailscale, with security checks at every step. Beginner-friendly, built with Claude Code.

title: walissonhms/orqst
summary: Your AI agents. One command center. Full visibility. Run Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode together, track token usage, automate handoffs and optimize every workflow. Local-first and open source.

title: okyanu/pomona
summary: Open edge-AI platform for greenhouse and hydroponic agriculture: MQTT sensor ingest, SQLite, compact reasoners (tomato, irrigation, nutrient/pH-EC), deterministic safety checks, and a read-only dashboard.

title: SuperCrzy/Supercrzy-Bot
summary: Self-hosted AI agent platform — 44 tools, 8 messaging channels, multi-vendor review. Bring your own model keys; sessions and memory stay on your machine.
